SELECT ri.*, COALESCE(applicant_count.count, 0) as applicantCount FROM recruitment_info ri LEFT JOIN ( SELECT recruitment_id, COUNT(*) as count FROM recruitment_admission WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY recruitment_id ) applicant_count ON ri.id = applicant_count.recruitment_id WHERE ri.deleted = 0
AND ri.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND ri.status = #{status}
ORDER BY ri.updated_time DESC
